glance: Saturday afternoon will mark the 40th meeting between Notre Dame and Stanford. The series stands at a 25-14-0 Notre Dame advantage all-time.
The Irish are 3-1 against the Cardinal under Freeman.
The two teams last faced off at Notre Dame Stadium on October 12, 2024, when the Irish defeated the Cardinal 49-7.
The Irish are 21-4 against current ACC opponents under Dick Corbett Head Coach Marcus Freeman. Freeman has five wins against ACC opponents in every season he has coached at Notre Dame.
The two teams play for the Legends Trophy, which is a combination of Irish crystal and California redwood.
The Notre Dame Club of the San Francisco area first presented the trophy in 1989.
